events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation. Which iconic performance from Woodstock 1969 still gives you chills?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who died on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to inspire generations. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Seventy-five years young for the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your top Oasis anthem or solo tune from the man himself?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating over 60 years of the iconic 007 film franchise.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! It's James Bond Day. What's your favourite Bond film and, more importantly, which theme tune is the ultimate 007 classic?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Eighty-six years since John Lennon came into the world. His music and message still resonate globally. What's the Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: Eighty-seven years of pure genius! Happy Birthday to the incomparable John Cleese. Which Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Legendary Frontman
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a true legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?
